title: Open Worship app — Resources link list
description: The default shape of a `.json` file in a Resources folder, named after the chapter it belongs to (`1CH.0.json`, `GEN.4.json`). Each entry becomes a pressable row under the file in the Resources panel, and pressing one opens its URL in the machine's own web browser. A `.json` that does not match this shape is not an error: the panel simply lists it as an ordinary file and hands it to whatever application the machine uses for it. The shape is implemented by `src/resources/resourceLinksHelpers.ts` and this file is the same rules written for an editor.

title.description: The words the row shows. Optional: an entry with no title, or a blank one, is titled with its own URL — a row with nothing to read would be a row nobody can press.

url.description: Where pressing the row goes. `http` or `https` ONLY: opening a URL hands it to the desktop, which will also launch whatever application has registered a scheme, so `file:`, `mailto:` and bespoke schemes are refused and the entry is dropped.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: a bare URL string is a link that titles itself.
